title: RecommendedAction
description: A recommendation, never an execution. The MVP is read-only: nothing here is ever run.

type.description: Composed from the two categories rather than listed again. Codex, chunk 0 round 5: a third copy of the six state-changing values lived here, so a new action could be added to this list, be missing from the category, and then require neither approval nor a target while every test stayed green. Adding a type now means choosing which category it belongs to — there is no list left to forget.

requires_approval.description: Must be true for anything that changes cluster state. Enforced below, not left to the model.

rationale.description: Why this action, tied to the root cause. An action with no reason is noise in an incident channel.

target.description: What the action would touch. Every field is required: a target object with nothing in it named nothing, and a recommendation that names nothing cannot be reviewed, approved, or refused.

executed.description: Required and always false in the MVP. A field that can only hold one value is a tripwire: the day something sets it to true, every validator fails loudly. It is required, not optional, because an absent field would read as read-only compliance that nobody ever stated — the exact silence this schema exists to refuse.

allOf.description: Every state-changing action requires approval. The model does not get to decide this.
no_action changes nothing, so it cannot carry a risk above low or demand approval.
A state-changing action must say what it would change. Approval on an unnamed target is approval of nothing.

stateChangingType.description: The actions that would change the cluster. Codex, chunk 0 round 4: this list existed three times — twice inline and once with an action type that does not exist at all — so a rule written for every state-changing action silently covered only some of them. One carrier now; anything that must ask about state change refers here.

nonStateChangingType.description: Actions that touch nothing: they need no target and no approval.
